label: Whatever has received esse is given being by something at its first moment
paraphrase: OPEN analyst premise, attribution deferred (onset is given): in every history of the model, whatever has its esse received in some principle (DEF-ESSE-RECEIVED-IN) is given being by something (GivesAt, definition 158301bc, STRICT reading) at a first moment of its presence (BeginsAt: present then and at no strictly earlier moment). The existential-inertia rival accepts it: its causal requirement on change (Schmid 2021, read) covers coming to be, and the inertial interpretation satisfies it (Control part 5). Silent on things with no first moment of presence.
